in_marathi.name: Hethvikaa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hethvikaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit roots 'Hetu' (cause) and 'Vikaa' (prosperity or wealth), Hethvikaa is a name of the Goddess Lakshmi, who is revered for her ability to bestow wealth and prosperity upon her devotees.
